## Change

Describe the smallest coherent change and the relevant specification.

## Evidence

List only checks actually run, with results. Mark unavailable checks as unverified.

## Review

Confirm content accuracy, desktop/mobile composition, accessibility, base-path behavior, and absence of unintended hydration. Include actual screenshots when the UI changed.

## Release boundary

Actions remain paused. No merge, publication, new automatic workflow, or repository setting change without Martin's approval.
